headline: Second Hull player flips car outside training ground - reports

headline: Spain's Víctor Muñoz on Liverpool switch: Premier League more physical than LaLiga
description: Liverpool winger Víctor Muñoz has praised the "intensity" at the Premier League club since making the switch from LaLiga this summer, saying the change is "helping me grow" as a player.

headline: Portugal, Man United, Real Madrid: Cristiano Ronaldo's long history of rows with coaches
description: Cristiano Ronaldo walked out of the Portugal national team's camp after being benched. It is far from the first high-profile row of his two decades at the top.

headline: Roberto De Zerbi receives backing of Tottenham's chief executive
description: Chief executive Vinai Venkatesham has offered his backing to Roberto De Zerbi after Tottenham's poor start to the new campaign.
